# Time series decomposition
- Time series decomposition splits/decomposes time series data 
- This splits up the data into 3:  
- - Trend - represents long term movements ie. slow change over years  
- - Seasonality - represents repeating patterns over fixed periods ie. months/years  
- - Resisuals - random fluctuations which remain after trends and easonality have been accounted for ie. unexpected stress events  
- Comparing decomposition components of the observed vs. fitted data could help to see where models are missing

```{R}
# load in data and convert to tsibbles for time series
# also fill gaps (from weird ET earlier) for these time series analyses
preds_GAM <- read_csv(here("data/main/16_ML_results/GAM_preds_results.csv")) %>%
    as_tsibble(key = c(Site_ID, model), index = Date) %>%
    fill_gaps()
    
preds_RF <- read_csv(here("data/main/16_ML_results/RF_preds_results.csv")) %>%
    as_tsibble(key = c(Site_ID, model), index = Date) %>%
    fill_gaps()

```

# 2. Decomposition
- trying out time series decomposition at one site  

```{R}
# select
site = "US-Blo"
mod = "no_age"


dcmp_pred <- preds_RF %>%
    filter(Site_ID == site,
           model == mod) %>%
    
    # decompose time series
    # smaller window = more wiggly. Inf window forces identical seasonal shape yera on year so not good to use here
    model(STL(predicted_ET ~ season(window = 20))) %>%
    
    # for binding
    components() %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(ET = predicted_ET) %>%
    mutate(source = "Predicted")



dcmp_obs<- preds_RF %>%
    filter(Site_ID == site,
           model == mod) %>%
    
    # decompose time series
    # smaller window = more wiggly. Inf window forces identical seasonal shape yera on year so not good to use here
    model(STL(observed_ET ~ season(window = 20))) %>%
    
    # for binding
    components() %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(ET = observed_ET) %>%
    mutate(source = "Observed")

dcmp_pred
```

- plotting decomposition 

```{R}
# bind both pred and obs decomps
dcmp_merge <- bind_rows(dcmp_obs, dcmp_pred)


dcmp_merge %>%
    
    # pivot long
    pivot_longer(cols = c(ET, trend, season_year, remainder), names_to = "component", values_to = "value") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = value, colour = source)) +
    geom_line(alpha=0.85) +
    
    # colour
    scale_colour_manual(name = NULL,
                          values = c("Predicted" = wes_palette("Darjeeling1")[2], 
                                     "Observed" = wes_palette("Darjeeling1")[3])) +
    
    # facet by component of the decomposition
    facet_wrap(~component, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{R}
decompose <- function(site, mod, arch){

    # decompose observed data
    dcmp_obs<- preds_RF %>%
        filter(Site_ID == site,
               model == mod,
               architecture == arch) %>%
        
        # decompose time series
        # smaller window = more wiggly. Inf window forces identical seasonal shape yera on year so not good to use here
        model(STL(observed_ET ~ season(window = 20))) %>%
        
        # for binding
        components() %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        rename(ET = observed_ET) %>%
        mutate(source = "Observed")
    
    
    # decompose predicted/fitted data
    dcmp_pred <- preds_RF %>%
        filter(Site_ID == site,
               model == mod,
               architecture == arch) %>%
        
        # decompose time series
        # smaller window = more wiggly. Inf window forces identical seasonal shape yera on year so not good to use here
        model(STL(predicted_ET ~ season(window = 20))) %>%
        
        # for binding
        components() %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        rename(ET = predicted_ET) %>%
        mutate(source = "Predicted")
    
    
    # bind both pred and obs decomps
    dcmp_merge <- bind_rows(dcmp_obs, dcmp_pred)
    
    dcmp_p <- dcmp_merge %>%
        
        # pivot long
        pivot_longer(cols = c(ET, trend, season_year, remainder), names_to = "component", values_to = "value") %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = value, colour = source)) +
        geom_line(alpha = 0.75) +
        
        theme_minimal() +
        
        # colour
        scale_colour_manual(name = NULL,
                          values = c("Predicted" = wes_palette("Darjeeling1")[2], 
                                     "Observed" = wes_palette("Darjeeling1")[3])) +
        
        ggtitle(paste("Time series decomposition of ", arch, " (Model: ", mod, ")", " at ", site, sep = "")) +
        
        
        # facet by component of the decomposition
        facet_wrap(~component, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") 
        
    dcmp_p
    
}

```

```{R}
decompose("US-Blo", "no_age_no_lai", "RF")
```
